rationale: Re-review after upstream changed first-match resolution to conservative candidate retention and added four selection regressions. All nine declarations and expanded tables exercise real graph/selection behavior; unchanged source retained.

cases.title: tracks transitive public workspace source consumers including type and dynamic imports
cases.reason: Real temporary workspace files select all transitive static, dynamic, require and type consumers; throwing source/stale dist must never execute.

cases.title: tracks package manifests as inputs to all public consumers
cases.reason: Both process-host and transitive byte-buffer manifest changes retain all four public consumers while excluding the unrelated file.

cases.title: does not silently drop unresolved internal imports: %s
cases.reason: Unknown internal package and private subpath independently reject rather than silently dropping dependency edges.

cases.title: keeps real test consumers of %s when another covered source changes
cases.reason: Five assigned/direct/computed/optional loader fixtures retain their actual downstream test consumer alongside a separate covered input, without selecting the unrelated fixture.
parameter_rows: computed namespace createRequire escaping through object

cases.title: retains every existing candidate across literal paths, extensions and index files
cases.reason: Independent fixture graph expectations protect every plausible competing literal/extension/index candidate, aliases and JSON; opaque missing/dynamic/config/test owners remain conservative.

cases.title: keeps extensionless consumers when a covered JavaScript sibling changes
cases.reason: A competing TypeScript sibling must not hide the extensionless consumer when JavaScript changes; the explicit JavaScript consumer and unrelated negative control constrain selection.

cases.title: follows transitive imports through a competing .%s source
cases.reason: Each JSX/MTS/CTS/MJS/CJS sibling carries a real transitive input; collect plus select must retain extensionless and direct consumers while excluding unrelated tests.

cases.title: retains TypeScript substitutions for .%s imports through .%s
cases.reason: Five emitted-to-source substitutions retain both import forms despite a deliberately competing output-name.ts file.

cases.title: retains directory consumers whose manifest can override an index file
cases.reason: A real directory manifest redirects to a JavaScript transitive owner; the consumer remains opaque/conservative rather than being lost behind the index file.
